title: Why a Small Choice Can Feel Exhausting
short_teaser: Decisions use attention, comparison, memory, and emotional prediction.
story: Decisions use attention, comparison, memory, and emotional prediction. When many choices accumulate, even a minor decision can feel disproportionately difficult. Reducing unnecessary choices can protect energy for decisions that truly matter. Curiosity loosens assumptions. A better question can reveal options that certainty would have hidden. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Reducing unnecessary choices can protect energy for decisions that truly matter. Curiosity loosens assumptions. A better question can reveal options that certainty would have hidden.
spark_application: Take one assumption you have been treating as fixed and turn it into three open questions. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
